name: poselib
description: Minimal solvers for calibrated camera pose estimation. Pinned to cdcseacave/PoseLib commit f81608046322944fae8a11d453f71fb552bbc4ce from feature/spherical-camera-support (upstream PoseLib master up to #215), with unified bearing-vector estimate_* API for pinhole and spherical (equirectangular) cameras; opt.max_error is angular (radians) for the bearing estimators.
